author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Since September I've been busily setting up interviews to learn a bit more about what's going on at Rackham Studios who are hard at work bringing the world of Aarklash to its fans. Today I'm joined by Stephan and Capucine who are hard at work on the lore for the game to share what they can so far about who they are and how the previous work will influence what they're doing for INCARNATION which launches next year!
